reason: I've never heard of this store, and I'm not putting $360 on a light from a site I can't vouch for. Two weeks of waiting on top of that and I'm paying to send it back if I don't like it, so I'd just keep looking and wait for a sale somewhere I know.
objection: Unknown store, 10 to 12 business days for an in-stock light, and I eat the return shipping on a bulky fixture if it looks different in my room.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, or real customer photos and reviews from people who bought, plus faster delivery on in-stock pieces.
